title: 数据提供与 Timeline
html:
数据提供与 Timeline

核心概念

概述

数据提供是小组件运转的核心引擎。iOS 通过 TimelineProvider 协议将"提供什么数据"和"何时更新"解耦——你提供一组带时间戳的 TimelineEntry 和一个刷新策略，系统负责在合适的时机渲染和更新。Android 通过 Glance 的 per-GlanceId 持久化状态和 update/updateAll 方法实现类似的数据驱动更新。

与 小组件生命周期与刷新 紧密关联，数据提供层的设计直接决定 widget 的更新效率、数据新鲜度和电池消耗。核心原则是：缓存优先、批量预计算、优雅降级。

flowchart TD
    subgraph "数据源"
        NET["远程 API<br/>Network"]
        LOC["本地数据库<br/>CoreData / Room"]
        SHARED["共享存储<br/>App Group / ContentProvider"]

    subgraph "数据转换层"
        PARSE["数据解析<br/>JSON → Model"]

    subgraph "iOS TimelineProvider"
        PH["placeholder()<br/>占位数据"]
        SN["getSnapshot()<br/>快速快照"]

iOS TimelineProvider 深入

协议定义

public protocol TimelineProvider {
    associatedtype Entry: TimelineEntry

    /// 提供占位数据 — 添加 widget 时的瞬时展示
    func placeholder(in context: Context) -> Entry

    /// 提供快速快照 — Widget 库预览、Smart Stack
    func getSnapshot(in context: Context, completion: @escaping (Entry) -> Void)

    /// 提供完整时间线 — 可执行网络请求
    func getTimeline(in context: Context, completion: @escaping (Timeline<Entry>) -> Void)
}

TimelineEntry 结构设计

TimelineEntry 需要一个 date 属性，系统根据当前时间选择最合适的 entry 进行展示：

struct WeatherEntry: TimelineEntry {
    let date: Date                    // 必填：entry 的时间点
    let temperature: Double           // 业务数据
    let condition: String
    let symbolName: String
    let location: String
    let hourlyForecast: [HourlyForecast]
    let high: Int
    let low: Int
    let humidity: Int
    let isPlaceholder: Bool           // 标记是否为占位数据
}

struct HourlyForecast: Identifiable {
    let id = UUID()
    let time: Date
    let temp: Int
    let symbolName: String
}

设计建议： Entry 应该是一个包含所有展示所需数据的"快照"结构体。避免在 View 中进行异步数据加载——所有数据应在 getTimeline 中准备好。

getTimeline 批量预计算

getTimeline 的核心价值是一次提供多条未来 entry，让系统在不重新加载 widget 进程的情况下自动切换显示内容：

func getTimeline(in context: Context, completion: @escaping (Timeline<WeatherEntry>) -> Void) {
    // 1. 从共享缓存读取最新数据
    let cached = WeatherCache.shared.latest

    // 2. 发起网络请求获取最新数据
    WeatherAPI.shared.fetchCurrentAndForecast(location: cached?.location ?? "北京") { result in
        switch result {
        case .success(let response):
            var entries: [WeatherEntry] = []
            let now = Date()
            let calendar = Calendar.current

            // 3. 为当前时刻创建 entry
            let currentEntry = WeatherEntry(
                date: now,
                temperature: response.current.temp,
                condition: response.current.condition,
                symbolName: response.current.symbol,
                location: response.location,
                hourlyForecast: response.hourly.prefix(6).map { HourlyForecast(time: $0.time, temp: $0.temp, symbolName: $0.symbol) },
                high: response.daily[0].high,
                low: response.daily[0].low,
                humidity: response.current.humidity,
                isPlaceholder: false
            )
            entries.append(currentEntry)

            // 4. 为未来几小时创建 entry（每小时一次，共 5 条）
            for hour in 1...5 {
                guard let hourDate = calendar.date(byAdding: .hour, value: hour, to: now),
                      let forecast = response.hourly.first(where: {
                          calendar.isDate($0.time, equalTo: hourDate, toGranularity: .hour)
                      })
                else { continue }

                let hourEntry = WeatherEntry(
                    date: hourDate,
                    temperature: forecast.temp,
                    condition: forecast.condition,
                    symbolName: forecast.symbol,
                    location: response.location,
                    hourlyForecast: response.hourly
                        .filter { $0.time >= hourDate }
                        .prefix(6)
                        .map { HourlyForecast(time: $0.time, temp: $0.temp, symbolName: $0.symbol) },
                    high: response.daily[0].high,
                    low: response.daily[0].low,
                    humidity: forecast.humidity,
                    isPlaceholder: false
                )
                entries.append(hourEntry)
            }

            // 5. 缓存最新数据
            WeatherCache.shared.save(current: currentEntry, forecasts: response)

            // 6. 返回时间线 + 刷新策略
            // 最后一条 entry 过后重新请求（约 5 小时后）
            let timeline = Timeline(entries: entries, policy: .atEnd)
            completion(timeline)

        case .failure(let error):
            // 7. 失败时使用缓存数据 + 短重试策略
            let fallbackEntry = cached ?? WeatherEntry(
                date: Date(),
                temperature: 0,
                condition: "数据不可用",
                symbolName: "exclamationmark.triangle",
                location: "未知",
                hourlyForecast: [],
                high: 0,
                low: 0,
                humidity: 0,
                isPlaceholder: false
            )
            let retryDate = Date().addingTimeInterval(5 * 60)  // 5 分钟后重试
            let timeline = Timeline(entries: [fallbackEntry], policy: .after(retryDate))
            completion(timeline)
        }
    }
}

getSnapshot 缓存优先

getSnapshot 必须快速返回——系统对其有严格的超时限制：

func getSnapshot(in context: Context, completion: @escaping (WeatherEntry) -> Void) {
    if context.isPreview {
        // Widget 库预览：返回示例数据
        completion(WeatherEntry.snapshotPreview)
    } else {
        // 快速返回缓存数据，不做网络请求
        let entry = WeatherCache.shared.latest ?? WeatherEntry.snapshotPreview
        completion(entry)
    }
}

// 示例数据（用于 Widget 库预览）
extension WeatherEntry {
    static let snapshotPreview = WeatherEntry(
        date: Date(),
        temperature: 22,
        condition: "晴",
        symbolName: "sun.max.fill",
        location: "北京",
        hourlyForecast: [
            HourlyForecast(time: Date(), temp: 22, symbolName: "sun.max.fill"),
            HourlyForecast(time: Date().addingTimeInterval(3600), temp: 24, symbolName: "sun.max.fill"),
            HourlyForecast(time: Date().addingTimeInterval(7200), temp: 23, symbolName: "cloud.sun.fill")
        ],
        high: 26,
        low: 18,
        humidity: 45,
        isPlaceholder: false
    )
}

App Group 数据共享

Widget 扩展是独立进程，必须通过 App Group 与主应用共享数据。

UserDefaults 共享

// 定义 App Group ID（主应用和 widget 扩展的 Signing 中都要添加）
let appGroupID = "group.com.example.myapp"

class SharedDataStore {
    static let shared = SharedDataStore()

    private var defaults: UserDefaults {
        UserDefaults(suiteName: appGroupID)!
    }

    // 保存简单数据
    func saveWidgetConfig(_ config: WidgetConfig) {
        if let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(config) {
            defaults.set(data, forKey: "widget_config")
        }
    }

    func loadWidgetConfig() -> WidgetConfig? {
        guard let data = defaults.data(forKey: "widget_config"),
              let config = try? JSONDecoder().decode(WidgetConfig.self, from: data)
        else { return nil }
        return config
    }
}

struct WidgetConfig: Codable {
    let selectedCity: String
    let temperatureUnit: String
    let showHumidity: Bool
}

文件共享

对于大量数据（如缓存的天气数据、新闻列表），使用 App Group 容器中的文件：

class SharedFileStore {
    static let shared = SharedFileStore()

    private var containerURL: URL? {
        FileManager.default.containerURL(
            forSecurityApplicationGroupIdentifier: appGroupID
        )
    }

    func saveWeatherData(_ data: WeatherResponse) {
        guard let url = containerURL?.appendingPathComponent("weather_cache.json") else { return }
        if let encoded = try? JSONEncoder().encode(data) {
            try? encoded.write(to: url, options: .atomic)
        }
    }

    func loadWeatherData() -> WeatherResponse? {
        guard let url = containerURL?.appendingPathComponent("weather_cache.json"),
              let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url),
              let response = try? JSONDecoder().decode(WeatherResponse.self, from: data)
        else { return nil }
        return response
    }

    func lastUpdated() -> Date? {
        guard let url = containerURL?.appendingPathComponent("weather_cache.json"),
              let attrs = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: url.path),
              let modDate = attrs[.modificationDate] as? Date
        else { return nil }
        return modDate
    }
}

数据新鲜度检查

在 getTimeline 中检查缓存新鲜度，决定是否需要网络请求：

func getTimeline(in context: Context, completion: @escaping (Timeline<WeatherEntry>) -> Void) {
    let cache = SharedFileStore.shared

    // 检查缓存是否在 30 分钟内
    if let lastUpdate = cache.lastUpdated(),
       Date().timeIntervalSince(lastUpdate) < 30 * 60,
       let cachedData = cache.loadWeatherData() {
        // 缓存新鲜，直接使用
        let entries = buildEntries(from: cachedData)
        let timeline = Timeline(entries: entries, policy: .atEnd)
        completion(timeline)
        return
    }

    // 缓存过期，发起网络请求
    WeatherAPI.shared.fetch { result in
        // ... 处理结果
    }
}

Android Glance 状态管理

per-GlanceId 持久化状态

Glance 为每个 widget 实例（每个 GlanceId）提供独立的持久化状态：

@Serializable
data class WeatherWidgetState(
    val temperature: Int = 0,
    val condition: String = "加载中",
    val location: String = "北京",
    val lastUpdated: Long = 0L,
    val hourlyForecast: List<HourlyForecast> = emptyList()
)

@Serializable
data class HourlyForecast(
    val time: Long,
    val temp: Int,
    val condition: String
)

class WeatherWidget : GlanceAppWidget(
    sizeMode = SizeMode.Responsive(
        sizes = setOf(
            DpSize(180.dp, 110.dp),
            DpSize(270.dp, 200.dp)
        )
    )
) {
    override suspend fun provideGlance(context: Context, id: GlanceId) {
        // 读取当前持久化状态
        val currentState = currentState<WeatherWidgetState>()

        // 如果状态为空或过期，触发刷新
        if (currentState == null || isStateExpired(currentState)) {
            refreshData(context)
        }

        provideContent {
            // provideContent 中可以直接读取状态
            val state = currentState<WeatherWidgetState>()
                ?: WeatherWidgetState()

            WeatherWidgetContent(state)
        }
    }

    private fun isStateExpired(state: WeatherWidgetState): Boolean {
        val thirtyMinutesAgo = System.currentTimeMillis() - 30 * 60 * 1000
        return state.lastUpdated < thirtyMinutesAgo
    }
}

触发状态更新

从应用的其他部分（Activity、ViewModel、WorkManager）触发 widget 更新：

// 更新所有 widget 实例
suspend fun updateAllWeatherWidgets(context: Context, newData: WeatherResponse) {
    val state = WeatherWidgetState(
        temperature = newData.current.temp,
        condition = newData.current.condition,
        location = newData.location,
        lastUpdated = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        hourlyForecast = newData.hourly.map {
            HourlyForecast(time = it.time, temp = it.temp, condition = it.condition)
        }
    )
    WeatherWidget().updateAll(context, state)
}

// 更新单个 widget 实例
suspend fun updateSingleWidget(
    context: Context,
    glanceId: GlanceId,
    state: WeatherWidgetState
) {
    WeatherWidget().update(context, glanceId, state)
}

使用 WorkManager 定时刷新

class WeatherUpdateWorker(
    context: Context,
    params: WorkerParameters
) : CoroutineWorker(context, params) {

    override suspend fun doWork(): Result {
        return try {
            val data = WeatherAPI.fetchCurrent()
            updateAllWeatherWidgets(applicationContext, data)
            Result.success()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            if (runAttemptCount < 3) {
                Result.retry()
            } else {
                Result.failure()
            }
        }
    }

    companion object {
        fun schedulePeriodic(context: Context) {
            val request = PeriodicWorkRequestBuilder<WeatherUpdateWorker>(
                30, TimeUnit.MINUTES,     // 每 30 分钟
                5, TimeUnit.MINUTES       // 5 分钟弹性窗口
            )
                .setConstraints(
                    Constraints.Builder()
                        .setRequiredNetworkType(NetworkType.CONNECTED)
                        .build()
                )
                .build()

            WorkManager.getInstance(context).enqueueUniquePeriodicWork(
                "weather_widget_update",
                ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.UPDATE,
                request
            )
        }
    }
}

数据架构最佳实践

数据流向设计

sequenceDiagram
    participant App as 主应用
    participant Group as App Group / 持久化
    participant Widget as Widget 进程
    participant API as 远程 API

    App->>API: 用户操作触发网络请求
    API-->>App: 返回数据
    App->>Group: 写入共享数据
    App->>Widget: WidgetCenter.reloadTimelines()

    Note over Widget: 系统调度刷新
    Widget->>Group: 读取共享数据
    alt 缓存新鲜
        Group-->>Widget: 返回缓存数据
        Widget->>Widget: 构建 TimelineEntry
    else 缓存过期
        Widget->>API: 发起网络请求
        API-->>Widget: 返回数据
        Widget->>Group: 更新缓存
        Widget->>Widget: 构建 TimelineEntry
    end

缓存策略对比

策略 新鲜度 电池消耗 实现复杂度
每次都网络请求 最高 最高 低
固定时间间隔缓存 中等 中等 低
基于数据变化的智能缓存 高 低 高
推送驱动更新 高 低 中等

推荐缓存间隔

数据类型 推荐缓存时间 说明
天气 30 分钟 天气变化不频繁
新闻 15 分钟 需要一定时效性
股票 5 分钟 交易时段需要更高频率
日历 1 小时 事件变化少
健身数据 实时（推送驱动） 用户期望实时同步

错误处理与降级

iOS 降级策略

func getTimeline(in context: Context, completion: @escaping (Timeline<WeatherEntry>) -> Void) {
    WeatherAPI.shared.fetch { result in
        switch result {
        case .success(let data):
            // 正常路径
            let entries = self.buildEntries(from: data)
            completion(Timeline(entries: entries, policy: .atEnd))

        case .failure(let error):
            // 降级路径
            let fallback: WeatherEntry

            if let cached = SharedFileStore.shared.loadWeatherData() {
                // 有缓存：使用缓存 + 标记过期
                fallback = WeatherEntry(
                    date: Date(),
                    temperature: cached.current.temp,
                    condition: "\(cached.current.condition) (已过期)",
                    symbolName: cached.current.symbol,
                    location: cached.location,
                    hourlyForecast: [],
                    high: cached.daily[0].high,
                    low: cached.daily[0].low,
                    humidity: cached.current.humidity,
                    isPlaceholder: false
                )
            } else {
                // 无缓存：显示错误状态
                fallback = WeatherEntry(
                    date: Date(),
                    temperature: 0,
                    condition: "无法加载",
                    symbolName: "wifi.exclamationmark",
                    location: "未知",
                    hourlyForecast: [],
                    high: 0,
                    low: 0,
                    humidity: 0,
                    isPlaceholder: false
                )
            }

            // 5 分钟后重试
            let retryDate = Date().addingTimeInterval(5 * 60)
            completion(Timeline(entries: [fallback], policy: .after(retryDate)))
        }
    }
}

Android 降级策略

class WeatherUpdateWorker(
    context: Context,
    params: WorkerParameters
) : CoroutineWorker(context, params) {

    override suspend fun doWork(): Result {
        return try {
            val data = WeatherAPI.fetchCurrent()
            val state = WeatherWidgetState(
                temperature = data.current.temp,
                condition = data.current.condition,
                location = data.location,
                lastUpdated = System.currentTimeMillis()
            )
            WeatherWidget().updateAll(applicationContext, state)
            Result.success()
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            // 网络错误：使用缓存数据
            val cached = WeatherCache.load(applicationContext)
            if (cached != null) {
                val fallbackState = WeatherWidgetState(
                    temperature = cached.temp,
                    condition = "${cached.condition} (已过期)",
                    location = cached.location,
                    lastUpdated = cached.timestamp
                )
                WeatherWidget().updateAll(applicationContext, fallbackState)
            }
            // 30 秒后重试（指数退避）
            Result.retry()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            // 其他错误：显示错误状态
            val errorState = WeatherWidgetState(
                temperature = 0,
                condition = "加载失败",
                location = "未知",
                lastUpdated = System.currentTimeMillis()
            )
            WeatherWidget().updateAll(applicationContext, errorState)
            Result.failure()
        }
    }
}

小结

  • iOS TimelineProvider 三方法：placeholder 占位、getSnapshot 快速缓存、getTimeline 完整更新
  • getTimeline 应批量提供多条未来 entry，减少系统刷新次数
  • App Group 通过 UserDefaults(suiteName:) 和容器文件实现主应用与 widget 的数据共享
  • 数据新鲜度检查：30 分钟内的缓存可直接使用，避免不必要的网络请求
  • Android Glance 的 per-GlanceId 持久化状态通过 currentState<T>() 读取，update() / updateAll() 更新
  • WorkManager 实现灵活的定时刷新，配合 Constraints 限制网络和充电条件
  • 错误降级策略：有缓存用缓存（标记过期），无缓存显示错误状态，设置短重试间隔

相关内容请参阅 小组件生命周期与刷新 和 测试与调试。
